title: aaps-ci.yml does‘t allow line breaks in KEYSTORE_BASE64
symptom: The GitHub Actions workflow aaps-ci.yml does not allow line breaks in the KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret, which causes issues when the secret is generated using certutil on Windows, as it produces multi-line base64 output.
cause: The user generated the base64 secret using certutil on Windows, which produces multi-line base64 output, and the workflow's echo command does not handle line breaks in secrets.
fix: The suggested fix is to change the echo command to use a heredoc-style syntax to allow line breaks in the secret, but the maintainers argue that using the provided aaps-ci-preparation.html tool generates a single-line base64 and avoids the issue, so the change may not be needed.
evidence_quote: Please change the line echo "KEYSTORE_BASE64=${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV to echo "KEYSTORE_BASE64<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV or something else, so that line breaks in the secret KEYSTORE_BASE64 created during base64 encoding of the keystore.jks witch certutil would work.
